breakdown.description: Claiming to run a 2D simulation but using wall (noSlip) boundary conditions on front/back faces instead of empty.
breakdown.reason: The agent correctly identified that a 2D simulation requires the 'empty' boundary condition type for the front and back patches. The generated specification consistently applies this correction, stating 'with front/back patches set to empty to enforce 2D' for the mesh and 'Set front and back to empty' for every single field file (U, T, k, epsilon, nut, alphat, p, p_rgh).
